__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB datasource for database influx_wxm_app
__inputs.description: Select the Grafana InfluxDB datasource configured for influx_wxm_app (commonly UID influx-wxm-app).

description: Repo Annotation adoption, skill usage, content iteration, and workflow failure metrics from the influx_wxm_app InfluxDB database.

targets.query: SELECT SUM("value") AS "count" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_installed" WHERE $timeFilter AND "status" = 'success'

panels.description: Existing current or retired installations detected before refresh.

targets.query: SELECT SUM("value") AS "count" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_existing_install_detected" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Existing installs detected

targets.query: SELECT SUM("value") AS "count" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_used" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.description: Failures that stopped an instrumented workflow.

targets.query: SELECT SUM("value") AS "count" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_failure" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Workflow failures

targets.query: SELECT SUM("value") AS "installs" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_installed" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "install_action" fill(0)

SELECT "value", "status", "install_action", "install_adapters", "requested_adapters", "detected_adapters", "updated_adapters", "detected_plugins", "previous_versions", "current_version", "migration_backup_created", "install_mode", "plugins", "user_id", "git_user_name", "git_user_email", "target_repo_url", "repo_annotation_commit", "reason" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_installed" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000
SELECT SUM("value") AS "uses" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_used" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "skill_id" fill(0)
SELECT "value", "skill_id" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_used" WHERE $timeFilter LIMIT 10000
SELECT "value", "runtime" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_used" WHERE $timeFilter LIMIT 10000
SELECT "value", "status" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_completed" WHERE $timeFilter LIMIT 10000
SELECT "value", "skill_id" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_completed" WHERE $timeFilter LIMIT 10000

SELECT "value", "skill_id", "workflow", "stage", "status", "runtime", "user_id", "git_user_email", "target_repo_url", "reason" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_used" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000
SELECT SUM("value") AS "count" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_content_iteration" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.description: Revision events attributed to human or review feedback.

targets.query: SELECT SUM("value") AS "count" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_content_iteration" WHERE $timeFilter AND "reason" =~ /human|review/

panels.title: Human/review revisions

panels.description: Revision events attributed to validation feedback.

targets.query: SELECT SUM("value") AS "count" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_content_iteration" WHERE $timeFilter AND "reason" =~ /validation/

panels.title: Validation revisions

panels.description: Revision events attributed to conformance feedback.

targets.query: SELECT SUM("value") AS "count" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_content_iteration" WHERE $timeFilter AND "reason" =~ /conformance/

panels.title: Conformance revisions

targets.query: SELECT SUM("value") AS "revisions" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_content_iteration" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "reason" fill(0)
SELECT "value", "skill_id" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_content_iteration" WHERE $timeFilter LIMIT 10000
SELECT "value", "reason" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_content_iteration" WHERE $timeFilter LIMIT 10000

SELECT "value", "skill_id", "content_kind", "iteration_count", "reason", "workflow", "stage", "runtime", "user_id", "target_repo_url" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_content_iteration" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000
SELECT SUM("value") AS "failures" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_failure" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "failure_kind" fill(0)
SELECT "value", "failure_kind" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_failure" WHERE $timeFilter LIMIT 10000
SELECT "value", "skill_id" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_failure" WHERE $timeFilter LIMIT 10000

SELECT "value", "skill_id", "failure_kind", "stop_reason", "reason", "workflow", "stage", "runtime", "user_id", "git_user_email", "target_repo_url" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_failure" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000

panels.description: Shows the manually emitted connectivity-validation event.

targets.query: SELECT "value", "skill_id", "workflow", "stage", "status", "runtime", "user_id", "git_user_email", "target_repo_url", "reason", "repo_annotation_commit" FROM "cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_used" WHERE $timeFilter AND "skill_id" = 'grafana-validation' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Grafana validation events
